gen-archivo-black-gf-scope-one: Scope One has a traditional text serif feel, with counters spilling into the space around them and short, stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Archivo Black earns its keep big and brief.
gen-archivo-black-gf-slabo-13px: Archivo Black plants an authoritative, urban slab of a heading, its x-height filling the middle of every line. Slabo 13px follows with a bookish text serif, and its large open counters are the pair's strongest quality.
gen-archivo-black-gf-suwannaphum: Archivo Black has an x-height that fills the middle of the line. Suwannaphum answers in a dignified classic serif with a wide-open c, so a heading sized up generously gives it room to breathe.
gen-audiowide-fs-bespoke-slab: Audiowide draws its letters like tiles with wide grout lines, every stroke the same weight. Bespoke Slab, a grounded serif with tall bodies in every lowercase letter, would look oddly crowded if the heading shrank too small.
gen-audiowide-fs-erode: Futuristic tiles meet a pen-drawn serif. Audiowide is best at steady, unshaded outlines with a tech edge, while Erode does its best work with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight and a broad aperture on the g and a.
gen-audiowide-fs-trench-slab: Futuristic and tech-minded, Audiowide keeps one compass-pencil line weight and lets its tall lowercase stand up against the capitals. And Trench Slab, a dignified text serif with almost no gap between x-height and caps, is built for steady reading.
gen-audiowide-gf-domine: Audiowide draws its letters as if with a ballpoint pen. Domine, a classic serif with compact ascenders and a breathing space inside every curve, adds thin strokes slightly lighter than thick ones, giving the page a firm footing under the tech heading.
gen-audiowide-gf-esteban: Tile-like letters, then a refined surprise. Esteban is a text serif with mild stress and a wide-open e, so a longer passage stays solid and readable beneath Audiowide's single unchanging line weight.
gen-audiowide-gf-faustina: Audiowide holds one constant pen width, futuristic and tech to its core. Faustina, a text serif with an open-jawed c and gently thinning bowls, gives the pair its strongest quality: a modern heading over a classic, authoritative voice.
gen-audiowide-gf-halant: Audiowide has no tapering where strokes meet or end, and its lowercase stands tall against its capitals. Halant, a text serif with outward-pointing terminals and a modest thick and thin rhythm, makes paragraphs feel authoritative, with an x-height that towers.
